planets.name: TOI-2266 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2266 with a 2.33-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-2266 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2266. Its orbit and size follow Parviainen et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
